name: Tradia Agentic Trading OS
description: Risk-first agentic trading intelligence for proposals, journals, reports and public accountability.

tools.name: tradia_trade_propose
tools.description: Generate a structured trade proposal with risk analysis, invalidation, and safety warnings. Not financial advice.

tools.name: tradia_risk_check
tools.description: Check risk parameters for a trade idea. Returns approval status, violations, and warnings.

tools.name: tradia_trade_journal
tools.description: Create a journal entry for a completed trade with lessons and discipline score.

tools.name: tradia_performance_analyze
tools.description: Analyze trading performance including win rate, profit factor, expectancy, and drawdown.

tools.name: tradia_backtest_simulate
tools.description: Run a backtest simulation on historical trades with equity curve and drawdown analysis.

tools.name: tradia_public_update_generate
tools.description: Generate a public accountability update explaining trades and performance.

tools.name: tradia_accountability_card
tools.description: Generate an accountability card combining trade details, journal entries, and performance.

rules: All trade outputs must include humanReviewRequired: true
All trade outputs must include notFinancialAdvice: true

prompts.name: risk-check-trade
prompts.description: Risk-check a trade idea before considering it
prompts.template: Use Tradia to risk-check this {{symbol}} {{direction}} trade idea. Account balance: ${{balance}}. Risk: {{riskPercent}}%. Entry: {{entry}}. Stop: {{stopLoss}}. Target: {{takeProfit}}.

prompts.name: journal-trade
prompts.description: Journal a completed trade for review
prompts.template: Use Tradia to journal this completed {{symbol}} trade. Direction: {{direction}}. Entry: {{entry}}. Exit: {{exit}}. P&L: ${{pnl}}. R: {{rMultiple}}.
